sentences.text:
Author: Ninala Jayasurya
Bench: Ninala Jayasurya
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya
 Criminal Petition No.3052 of 2020
Order:

(Heard and pronounced through Blue Jeans App(virtual) mode, since this mode is adopted on account of prevalence of COVID-19 Pandemic) Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing the learned Public Prosecutor.

2. The present Criminal Petition has been filed seeking quash of FIR No.86 of 2019, dated 11.12.2019 on the file of Vakadu police station, SPSR Nellore District, by invoking the powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C.

entities.text: Vakadu police station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The said FIR has been registered against the petitioners for the alleged offences under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner inter-alia contended that the registration of FIR against the petitioner under the said offences is without jurisdiction and the provisions of the said Act are not attracted to the facts of the present case.
Learned counsel further places reliance on the Judgment dated 21.07.2020 of this court passed in Criminal Petition No.2408 of 2020.

In the said Judgment,
this court while following the orders passed in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 dated 18.12.2019,
wherein it was held that "Tobacco does not fall within the definition of 'Food' as specified under Section 3 (i) (j) of the Act and Registration of FIR is not permissible" quashed the FIR registered against the petitioner therein.
4. Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor fairly submitted that the issue raised in the present Criminal Petition is covered by the said Judgment dated 21.07.2020 passed in 2408 of 2020.

5. Having perused the order in Criminal Petition No.2408 of 2020 dated 21.07.2020 and after considering the submissions of both the learned counsel, this Court is of the opinion that the present case also stands on the similar lines and accordingly the FIR registered against the petitioners deserves to be quashed.

6. Accordingly, following the orders in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 dated 18.12.2019 and 2408 of 2020 dated 21.07.2020, the present Criminal Petition is allowed and FIR No.86 of 2019 dated 11.12.2019 on the file of Vakadu police station, SPSR Nellore District is hereby quashed.
Consequently, no further action is necessary in the facts of the present case.
Consequently, Miscellaneous Petitions pending, if any, in the Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
